stock.description: China Xinhua Education Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides higher and secondary vocational education services in the People's Republic of China. The company operates four private schools, which include Anhui Xinhua University that offers undergraduate and junior college programs focusing on engineering and management, economics, education, literature, medical studies, and arts; Clinical College of Anhui Medical University, an undergraduate university that offers a range of medical undergraduate courses, including clinical medicine, pharmacy, public affairs management, nursing, biomedical engineering, rehabilitation therapy, and medical imaging technique; Nanjing University of Finance & Economics Hongshan College; and Anhui Xinhua School, a full-time secondary vocational school. It also offers technical and management consultancy services. China Xinhua Education Group Limited was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Hefei, China.
